title: Ninja ZX-10R KRT (Classic Heritage)
description: The Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R KRT (Classic Heritage) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Middleweight Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
